title: Docs for kit export: tools, concepts, glossary, design note, vocabulary, README
description:
## Intent

Document kit export where people look: the docs (also the web app's Docs tab), the glossary, the design note.

## Scope

- `docs/tools.md`: an "Exporting to a DAW" section with `apricity export --kit`, its flags and an example.
- `docs/concepts.md` (Kits: slices and pads): one paragraph on taking a kit to the DAW as a drum rack, and what does not travel with it (effects, chord-following).
- `docs/glossary.md`: "Drum rack preset" and "Export" entries.
- `design/daw-presets.md`: update to what was built (pad table, what a preset cannot hold); `design/vocabulary.md`: the drum rack preset row.
- README layout table: the `apricity-daw` row (if the crate chore did not add it).
- Words: never the vendor's name or the DAW's product name; say "the DAW", "drum rack", "sampler".

## Verification

```sh
node web/test/docs.test.mjs 2>/dev/null || true   # if the docs tab has a link check
```
A case-insensitive grep of docs/, design/ and README.md for the vendor's name prints nothing. A reviewer reads the new docs section and runs its example command.

## Release

`docs(<this task id>): kit export`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task.
